description: Source code for helper functions related to creating and configuring media player parameters, including audio and video stream info, based on codecs and configuration, with functions to create player parameters and determine preferred output mode.

methods.name: CreateAudioStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates and returns an AudioStreamInfo object configured for a given audio codec.

methods.name: CreateVideoStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates and returns a VideoStreamInfo object configured for a given video codec.

methods.name: CreatePlayerCreationParam
methods.description: Creates a PlayerCreationParam object based on specified audio/video codecs and output mode.

methods.name: CreatePlayerCreationParam
methods.description: Creates a PlayerCreationParam object from a configuration, reading stream info from files if filenames are provided.

methods.name: GetPreferredOutputMode
methods.description: Returns the preferred output mode for a given PlayerCreationParam.
